func TestGenDb_P2PSubscriptionCreation_F05(t *testing.T) {
    mockUsers, mockTopics, _, _, mockAuthHandler, cleanup := setupTestEnv(t)
    defer cleanup()

    user1ID := "usrUSERP2P1" // Example IDs/UIDs
    user1UID := types.Uid(33445)
    user2ID := "usrUSERP2P2"
    user2UID := types.Uid(66778)

    inputData := &Data{
        Users: []User{
            {Username: "user1", Password: "pw1", State: "ok"},
            {Username: "user2", Password: "pw2", State: "ok"},
        },
        P2psubs: []P2PSub{ // Use P2PSub from main
            {
                Users: []P2PUser{ // Use P2PUser from main
                    {Name: "user1", Want: "RW", Have: "R", Private: tPrivate{"comment": "u1 priv"}},
                    {Name: "user2"}, // Defaults
                },
                CreatedAt: "-3h",
            },
        },
        datapath: ".",
    }

    // Expected values
    // Ensure consistent P2P name generation (lexicographical order of UIDs)
    expectedTopicName := user1UID.P2PName(user2UID) // types.Uid method handles order
    expectedWant1 := types.ModeRead | types.ModeWrite // RW
    expectedGiven1 := types.ModeRead                  // R
    expectedPrivate1 := tPrivate{"comment": "u1 priv"}
    expectedWant2 := types.ModeCP2P  // Default
    expectedGiven2 := types.ModeCP2P // Default

    // Mock user creation
    // Auth Init handled by setup
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.MatchedBy(func(u *types.User) bool { return strings.Contains(u.Tags[0], "basic:user1") }), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) { args.Get(0).(*types.User).Id = user1ID; args.Get(0).(*types.User).ObjHeader.SetUid(user1UID) }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: user1ID}}, nil).Once()
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.MatchedBy(func(u *types.User) bool { return strings.Contains(u.Tags[0], "basic:user2") }), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) { args.Get(0).(*types.User).Id = user2ID; args.Get(0).(*types.User).ObjHeader.SetUid(user2UID) }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: user2ID}}, nil).Once()
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(r *auth.Rec) bool { return r.Uid == user1UID }), mock.Anything, "").Return("auth1", nil).Once()
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(r *auth.Rec) bool { return r.Uid == user2UID }), mock.Anything, "").Return("auth2", nil).Once()

    // Mock P2P creation
    mockTopics.On("CreateP2P",
        mock.MatchedBy(func(sub1 *types.Subscription) bool {
            // Check sub1 details (user1)
            return sub1.User == user1ID && sub1.Topic == expectedTopicName &&
                sub1.ModeWant == expectedWant1 && sub1.ModeGiven == expectedGiven1 &&
                assert.ObjectsAreEqual(expectedPrivate1, sub1.Private) // Use ObjectsAreEqual for maps
        }),
        mock.MatchedBy(func(sub2 *types.Subscription) bool {
            // Check sub2 details (user2)
            return sub2.User == user2ID && sub2.Topic == expectedTopicName &&
                sub2.ModeWant == expectedWant2 && sub2.ModeGiven == expectedGiven2 &&
                assert.Nil(t, sub2.Private) // User2 had no private data specified
        })).Return(nil).Once()

    // Act
    genDb(inputData)

    // Assert
    mockAuthHandler.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockUsers.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockTopics.AssertExpectations(t)
}

func TestGenDb_FormInsertion_J09(t *testing.T) {
    mockUsers, mockTopics, mockSubs, mockMessages, mockAuthHandler, cleanup := setupTestEnv(t)
    defer cleanup()
    topicCounter = 0 // Reset for consistency if needed, though not used here

    botUserID := "usrBOTUSER1" // Example IDs/UIDs
    botUserUID := types.Uid(50505)
    otherUserID := "usrOTHERUSERF"
    otherUserUID := types.Uid(60606)
    someotherUserID := "usrSOMEOTHER" // Need ID/UID for the third user
    someotherUserUID := types.Uid(70707)

    // Determine P2P topic names based on UIDs
    p2pTopicNameBotOther := botUserUID.P2PName(otherUserUID)
    p2pTopicNameOtherSome := otherUserUID.P2PName(someotherUserUID)

    inputData := &Data{
        Users: []User{
            {Username: "botuser", Password: "(random)", State: "ok"},   // botUserUID
            {Username: "otheruser", Password: "pw", State: "ok"},     // otherUserUID
            {Username: "someother", Password: "pw", State: "ok"},     // someotherUserUID
        },
        P2psubs: []P2PSub{
            {Users: []P2PUser{{Name: "botuser"}, {Name: "otheruser"}}}, // -> p2pTopicNameBotOther
            {Users: []P2PUser{{Name: "otheruser"}, {Name: "someother"}}},// -> p2pTopicNameOtherSome (no bot)
        },
        Forms: []map[string]interface{}{
            {"txt": "form 1 content"},
            {"txt": "form 2 content"},
        },
        Messages: []string{"initial message"}, // Needed for seq ID > 0 path
        datapath: ".",
    }

    // Mock setup
    // Auth Init handled by setup
    // User Creation
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.MatchedBy(func(u *types.User) bool { return strings.Contains(u.Tags[0], "basic:botuser") }), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) { args.Get(0).(*types.User).Id = botUserID; args.Get(0).(*types.User).ObjHeader.SetUid(botUserUID) }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: botUserID}}, nil).Once()
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.MatchedBy(func(u *types.User) bool { return strings.Contains(u.Tags[0], "basic:otheruser") }), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) { args.Get(0).(*types.User).Id = otherUserID; args.Get(0).(*types.User).ObjHeader.SetUid(otherUserUID) }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: otherUserID}}, nil).Once()
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.MatchedBy(func(u *types.User) bool { return strings.Contains(u.Tags[0], "basic:someother") }), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) { args.Get(0).(*types.User).Id = someotherUserID; args.Get(0).(*types.User).ObjHeader.SetUid(someotherUserUID) }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: someotherUserID}}, nil).Once()

    // Auth Records
    expectedBotPassword := getPassword(8) // "aaaaaaaa"
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(r *auth.Rec) bool { return r.Uid == botUserUID }), []byte("botuser:"+expectedBotPassword), "").Return("authBot", nil).Once()
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(r *auth.Rec) bool { return r.Uid == otherUserUID }), []byte("otheruser:pw"), "").Return("authOther", nil).Once()
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(r *auth.Rec) bool { return r.Uid == someotherUserUID }), []byte("someother:pw"), "").Return("authSome", nil).Once() // Fixed match for someother

    // P2P Topic Creation
    mockTopics.On("CreateP2P", mock.AnythingOfType("*types.Subscription"), mock.AnythingOfType("*types.Subscription")).Return(nil).Twice() // Once for each P2PSub

    // Mock initial message save (single message path)
    // It saves to the *first* P2P topic encountered in the loop where usedp2p[name] is false.
    // With the input order, this will be the botuser:otheruser topic.
    // The sender is the first user listed in that P2PSub ('botuser').
    mockMessages.On("Save", mock.MatchedBy(func(msg *types.Message) bool {
        return msg.Topic == p2pTopicNameBotOther && msg.SeqId == 1 && msg.Content == "initial message" && msg.From == botUserID
    }), nil, true).Return(nil, 1).Once()

    // Mock Messages.Save for the forms
    // These should ONLY be saved to the P2P topic involving the bot ('botuser').
    expectedFormContent1 := map[string]interface{}{"txt": "form 1 content"}
    expectedFormContent2 := map[string]interface{}{"txt": "form 2 content"}
    expectedHeaders := types.MessageHeaders{"mime": "text/x-drafty"}

    // Form 1 (SeqId will be 2 in the bot:other topic)
    mockMessages.On("Save", mock.MatchedBy(func(msg *types.Message) bool {
        // Added type assertion for Content comparison
        contentMap, ok := msg.Content.(map[string]interface{})
        return ok && msg.Topic == p2pTopicNameBotOther && msg.From == botUserID && msg.SeqId == 2 &&
            assert.ObjectsAreEqual(expectedHeaders, msg.Head) &&
            assert.ObjectsAreEqual(expectedFormContent1, contentMap)
    }), nil, true).Return(nil, 2).Once()

    // Form 2 (SeqId will be 3 in the bot:other topic)
    mockMessages.On("Save", mock.MatchedBy(func(msg *types.Message) bool {
        // Added type assertion for Content comparison
        contentMap, ok := msg.Content.(map[string]interface{})
        return ok && msg.Topic == p2pTopicNameBotOther && msg.From == botUserID && msg.SeqId == 3 &&
            assert.ObjectsAreEqual(expectedHeaders, msg.Head) &&
            assert.ObjectsAreEqual(expectedFormContent2, contentMap)
    }), nil, true).Return(nil, 3).Once()


    // Act
    genDb(inputData)

    // Assert
    mockAuthHandler.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockUsers.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockTopics.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockSubs.AssertExpectations(t) // No explicit group sub calls expected
    mockMessages.AssertExpectations(t)
    // Ensure no messages were saved to the other P2P topic
    mockMessages.AssertNotCalled(t, "Save", mock.MatchedBy(func(msg *types.Message) bool {
        return msg.Topic == p2pTopicNameOtherSome
    }), mock.Anything, mock.Anything)

Test Implementation:
func TestParsePublic_Scenarios_K10(t *testing.T) {
    // Setup: Temp dir and dummy photo file
    tmpDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "testParsePublic")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    defer os.RemoveAll(tmpDir)

    photoFileName := "test.jpg"
    photoFilePath := filepath.Join(tmpDir, photoFileName)
    photoData := []byte("dummy photo data")
    err = os.WriteFile(photoFilePath, photoData, 0644)
    require.NoError(t, err)

    // Scenario 1: Both Fn and Photo empty
    cardInput1 := &theCard{}
    result1 := parsePublic(cardInput1, tmpDir)
    assert.Nil(t, result1, "Scenario 1 Failed: Should return nil when both fn and photo are empty")

    // Scenario 2: Fn only
    cardInput2 := &theCard{Fn: "Just Name"}
    result2 := parsePublic(cardInput2, tmpDir)
    require.NotNil(t, result2, "Scenario 2 Failed: Result should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "Just Name", result2.Fn, "Scenario 2 Failed: Fn mismatch")
    assert.Nil(t, result2.Photo, "Scenario 2 Failed: Photo should be nil")

    // Scenario 3: Photo only (using path from argument)
    cardInput3 := &theCard{Photo: photoFileName, Type: "image/jpeg"}
    result3 := parsePublic(cardInput3, tmpDir)
    require.NotNil(t, result3, "Scenario 3 Failed: Result should not be nil")
    assert.Empty(t, result3.Fn, "Scenario 3 Failed: Fn should be empty")
    require.NotNil(t, result3.Photo, "Scenario 3 Failed: Photo should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "image/jpeg", result3.Photo.Type, "Scenario 3 Failed: Type mismatch")
    assert.Equal(t, photoData, result3.Photo.Data, "Scenario 3 Failed: Data mismatch")

    // Scenario 4: Photo only (relative path in filename, needs base path)
    // filepath.Split("test.jpg") yields dir="", so base path 'tmpDir' is used.
    cardInput4 := &theCard{Photo: photoFileName, Type: "image/png"}
    result4 := parsePublic(cardInput4, tmpDir) // Provide base path
    require.NotNil(t, result4, "Scenario 4 Failed: Result should not be nil")
    require.NotNil(t, result4.Photo, "Scenario 4 Failed: Photo should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "image/png", result4.Photo.Type, "Scenario 4 Failed: Type mismatch")
    assert.Equal(t, photoData, result4.Photo.Data, "Scenario 4 Failed: Data mismatch")

    // Scenario 5: Both Fn and Photo
    cardInput5 := &theCard{Fn: "Full Name", Photo: photoFileName, Type: "image/gif"}
    result5 := parsePublic(cardInput5, tmpDir)
    require.NotNil(t, result5, "Scenario 5 Failed: Result should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "Full Name", result5.Fn, "Scenario 5 Failed: Fn mismatch")
    require.NotNil(t, result5.Photo, "Scenario 5 Failed: Photo should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "image/gif", result5.Photo.Type, "Scenario 5 Failed: Type mismatch")
    assert.Equal(t, photoData, result5.Photo.Data, "Scenario 5 Failed: Data mismatch")

    // Scenario 6: Photo with directory specified (absolute path)
    absPhotoPath, _ := filepath.Abs(photoFilePath)
    cardInput6 := &theCard{Photo: absPhotoPath, Type: "image/bmp"}
    result6 := parsePublic(cardInput6, "/different/path/ignored") // Base path ignored
    require.NotNil(t, result6, "Scenario 6 Failed: Result should not be nil")
    require.NotNil(t, result6.Photo, "Scenario 6 Failed: Photo should not be nil")
    assert.Equal(t, "image/bmp", result6.Photo.Type, "Scenario 6 Failed: Type mismatch")
    assert.Equal(t, photoData, result6.Photo.Data, "Scenario 6 Failed: Data mismatch")

    // Scenario 7: Photo file doesn't exist (leads to log.Fatal)
    // Cannot assert log.Fatal directly. TestParsePublic_ReadFileError_N18 covers this fatal path.

    // Scenario 8: Empty filename, non-empty Fn
    cardInput8 := &theCard{Fn: "Name Only", Photo: ""}
    result8 := parsePublic(cardInput8, tmpDir)
    require.NotNil(t, result8)
    assert.Equal(t, "Name Only", result8.Fn)
    assert.Nil(t, result8.Photo)
}

// Mock for twilioInit (assuming it's a package variable we can swap)
var mockTwilioInitCalled bool
var mockTwilioConf json.RawMessage
func mockTwilioInit_Success(conf json.RawMessage) error {
  mockTwilioInitCalled = true
  mockTwilioConf = conf
  return nil
}
func mockTwilioInit_Error(conf json.RawMessage) error {
  mockTwilioInitCalled = true
  mockTwilioConf = conf
  return errors.New("twilio init failed")
}


func TestValidatorInit_SuccessFull_456(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	v := &validator{}
	confJSON := `{
		"host_url": "https://secure.host",
		"languages": ["en", "es"],
		"universal_templ": "template_path_{{lang}}",
		"sender": "+15005550006",
		"max_retries": 5,
		"code_length": 8,
		"twilio_conf": {"sid": "ACxxxx", "token": "yyyy", "from": "+1zzzz"}
	}`
  twilioConfigJSON := json.RawMessage(`{"sid": "ACxxxx", "token": "yyyy", "from": "+1zzzz"}`)


	// Patch validate functions
	oldValidateHostURL := validate.ValidateHostURL
	oldReadTemplateFile := validate.ReadTemplateFile
	validate.ValidateHostURL = mockValidateHostURL_InitFull
	validate.ReadTemplateFile = mockReadTemplateFile_InitFull
	defer func() {
		validate.ValidateHostURL = oldValidateHostURL
		validate.ReadTemplateFile = oldReadTemplateFile
	}()

  // Patch twilioInit (assuming it's a package var)
  oldTwilioInit := twilioInit
  twilioInit = mockTwilioInit_Success
  mockTwilioInitCalled = false // Reset flag
  mockTwilioConf = nil
  defer func() { twilioInit = oldTwilioInit }()


	// Act
	err := v.Init(confJSON)

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "https://secure.host", v.HostUrl)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"en", "es"}, v.Languages)
	require.Len(t, v.universalTempl, 2)
	assert.NotNil(t, v.universalTempl[0])
	assert.NotNil(t, v.universalTempl[1])
	assert.NotNil(t, v.langMatcher)
  // Check matcher supports expected tags
  tagEn, _ := i18n.Parse("en")
  tagEs, _ := i18n.Parse("es")
  _, index, conf := v.langMatcher.Match(tagEn, tagEs)
  assert.NotEqual(t, i18n.No, conf) // Should have confidence
  assert.Contains(t, []int{0, 1}, index) // Should match one of the indices


	assert.Equal(t, "+15005550006", v.Sender)
	assert.Equal(t, 5, v.MaxRetries)
	assert.Equal(t, 8, v.CodeLength)
	expectedMaxCodeValue := big.NewInt(0).Exp(big.NewInt(10), big.NewInt(8), nil)
	assert.Equal(t, expectedMaxCodeValue, v.maxCodeValue)
	assert.NotNil(t, v.Twilio)
  assert.Equal(t, twilioConfigJSON, v.Twilio) // Check twilio config stored

  // Assert twilioInit mock was called
  assert.True(t, mockTwilioInitCalled, "twilioInit should have been called")
  assert.Equal(t, twilioConfigJSON, mockTwilioConf)

}

func TestValidatorPreCheck_ParseError_232(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	v := &validator{}
	// Using a number format likely to cause parse error, e.g., invalid country code prefix
	invalidPhoneNumber := "+12345" // Too short for international format?
	params := map[string]interface{}{"countryCode": "ZZ"} // Invalid region

	// Act
	result, err := v.PreCheck(invalidPhoneNumber, params)

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
  // Error could come from Parse or IsValidNumber, both should map to ErrMalformed
	assert.Equal(t, types.ErrMalformed, err) // Use types.ErrMalformed
	assert.Empty(t, result)
}

// Helper function to setup store mocks correctly
func setupStoreMocks_ReqNew(t *testing.T) (*storeMocks.UsersStorage, func()) {
	mockStore := new(storeMocks.UsersStorage)
	originalStoreUsers := store.Users
	store.Users = mockStore
	return mockStore, func() {
		store.Users = originalStoreUsers
	}
}

// Mock ExecuteTemplate for Request Success
var executedCode string
func mockExecuteTemplate_ReqSuccess(template *textt.Template, parts []string, params map[string]interface{}) (map[string]string, error) {
    code, okCode := params["Code"].(string)
    host, okHost := params["HostUrl"].(string)
    if !okCode || !okHost {
      return nil, errors.New("missing params in ExecuteTemplate mock")
    }
    executedCode = code // Store the code used in the template for assertion in send
    return map[string]string{"": "Code: " + code + ", Host: " + host}, nil
}


func TestValidatorRequest_SuccessNew_262(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_ReqNew(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{
		HostUrl:    "http://request.host",
		CodeLength: 6,
		maxCodeValue: big.NewInt(1000000), // 10^6
	}
	// Setup default template
	defaultTmpl, _ := textt.New("default").Parse("Code: {{.Code}}, Host: {{.HostUrl}}")
	v.universalTempl = []*textt.Template{defaultTmpl}

	uid := types.ParseUid("usrReqNew123")
	phone := "tel:+12345678900"
	lang := "en" // Will use default template

  var generatedResp string // To capture response generated for UpsertCred

	mockStore.On("UpsertCred", mock.MatchedBy(func(cred *types.Credential) bool {
		assert.Equal(t, uid.String(), cred.User)
		assert.Equal(t, validatorName, cred.Method)
		assert.Equal(t, phone, cred.Value)
		require.Len(t, cred.Resp, v.CodeLength, "Generated response length mismatch")
    generatedResp = cred.Resp // Capture the response
		return true
	})).Return(true, nil).Once() // isNew = true

  // Patch validate ExecuteTemplate
  oldExecuteTemplate := validate.ExecuteTemplate
  validate.ExecuteTemplate = mockExecuteTemplate_ReqSuccess
  executedCode = "" // Reset captured code
  defer func() { validate.ExecuteTemplate = oldExecuteTemplate }()


	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1) // Expect send to be called once

  // Mock the internal send method
  var sendCalled bool
  var sentTo, sentBody string
  originalSend := v.send // Need to capture original method if validator is reused
  v.send = func(to, body string) error {
    sendCalled = true
    sentTo = to
    sentBody = body
    wg.Done() // Signal goroutine finished
    return nil
  }
  defer func() { v.send = originalSend }() // Restore original


	// Act
	isNew, err := v.Request(uid, phone, lang, "", nil) // resp="", tmpToken=nil

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, isNew, "isNew should be true")

	// Wait for the send goroutine and check its parameters
	wg.Wait()
	assert.True(t, sendCalled, "v.send should have been called")
	assert.Equal(t, phone, sentTo)
  require.NotEmpty(t, generatedResp, "Generated response for UpsertCred was empty")
  require.NotEmpty(t, executedCode, "Code used in ExecuteTemplate was empty")
  assert.Equal(t, generatedResp, executedCode, "Code in DB and template should match")
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Code: "+generatedResp), "Sent body content mismatch (Code)")
  assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Host: "+v.HostUrl), "Sent body content mismatch (Host)")


	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
}

// Use mockExecuteTemplate_ReqSuccess from previous test

func TestValidatorRequest_SuccessUpdate_272(t *testing.T) {
  // Arrange
	mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_ReqUpdate(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{
		HostUrl:    "http://request.update",
		CodeLength: 4,
		maxCodeValue: big.NewInt(10000), // 10^4
	}
	defaultTmpl, _ := textt.New("default").Parse("Update Code: {{.Code}}")
	v.universalTempl = []*textt.Template{defaultTmpl}

	uid := types.ParseUid("usrReqUpd123")
	phone := "tel:+1112223333"
	lang := "en"

  var generatedResp string

	mockStore.On("UpsertCred", mock.MatchedBy(func(cred *types.Credential) bool {
		assert.Equal(t, uid.String(), cred.User)
		assert.Len(t, cred.Resp, v.CodeLength)
    generatedResp = cred.Resp
		return true
	})).Return(false, nil).Once() // isNew = false

  // Patch validate ExecuteTemplate
  oldExecuteTemplate := validate.ExecuteTemplate
  validate.ExecuteTemplate = mockExecuteTemplate_ReqSuccess
  executedCode = "" // Reset captured code
  defer func() { validate.ExecuteTemplate = oldExecuteTemplate }()

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1)
  var sendCalled bool
  var sentTo, sentBody string
  originalSend := v.send
  v.send = func(to, body string) error {
    sendCalled = true
    sentTo = to
    sentBody = body
    wg.Done()
    return nil
  }
  defer func() { v.send = originalSend }()

	// Act
	isNew, err := v.Request(uid, phone, lang, "", nil)

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.False(t, isNew, "isNew should be false")

	wg.Wait()
	assert.True(t, sendCalled)
	assert.Equal(t, phone, sentTo)
  require.NotEmpty(t, generatedResp)
  require.NotEmpty(t, executedCode)
  assert.Equal(t, generatedResp, executedCode)
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Code: "+generatedResp))
  assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Host: "+v.HostUrl))


	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
}

// Mock ExecuteTemplate returning error
var executeTemplateErr = errors.New("template execution failed")
func mockExecuteTemplate_Error(template *textt.Template, parts []string, params map[string]interface{}) (map[string]string, error) {
    return nil, executeTemplateErr
}


func TestValidatorRequest_ExecuteTemplateError_303(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_ReqTmplErr(t)
	defer cleanup() // Although store shouldn't be called

	v := &validator{
		HostUrl:    "http://tmpl.err",
		CodeLength: 6,
		maxCodeValue: big.NewInt(1000000), // Needed for code generation attempt
	}
	defaultTmpl, _ := textt.New("default").Parse("Valid template syntax") // Template itself is valid
	v.universalTempl = []*textt.Template{defaultTmpl}

	uid := types.ParseUid("usrTmplErr1")
	phone := "tel:+19998887777"

  // Patch validate ExecuteTemplate to return error
  oldExecuteTemplate := validate.ExecuteTemplate
  validate.ExecuteTemplate = mockExecuteTemplate_Error
  defer func() { validate.ExecuteTemplate = oldExecuteTemplate }()

  // Ensure send is NOT called
  sendCalled := false
  originalSend := v.send
  v.send = func(to, body string) error {
      sendCalled = true // Should not happen
      return nil
  }
  defer func() { v.send = originalSend }()


	// Act
	isNew, err := v.Request(uid, phone, "en", "", nil)

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, executeTemplateErr, err)
	assert.False(t, isNew)
  assert.False(t, sendCalled, "send should not have been called")

  // Ensure store was not called
  mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "UpsertCred", mock.Anything)
}

    return map[string]string{"": "Some content for upsert test"}, nil

func TestValidatorRequest_UpsertCredError_313(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_ReqUpsertErr(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{
		HostUrl:    "http://upsert.err",
		CodeLength: 6,
		maxCodeValue: big.NewInt(1000000),
	}
	defaultTmpl, _ := textt.New("default").Parse("Code: {{.Code}}")
	v.universalTempl = []*textt.Template{defaultTmpl}

	uid := types.ParseUid("usrUpsertErr")
	phone := "tel:+12345678900"
	expectedErr := errors.New("database upsert error")

	mockStore.On("UpsertCred", mock.AnythingOfType("*types.Credential")).Return(false, expectedErr).Once()

  // Patch validate ExecuteTemplate to succeed
  oldExecuteTemplate := validate.ExecuteTemplate
  validate.ExecuteTemplate = mockExecuteTemplate_ReqUpsertErr
  defer func() { validate.ExecuteTemplate = oldExecuteTemplate }()


  // Ensure send is NOT called
  sendCalled := false
  originalSend := v.send
  v.send = func(to, body string) error {
      sendCalled = true // Should not happen
      return nil
  }
  defer func() { v.send = originalSend }()

	// Act
	isNew, err := v.Request(uid, phone, "en", "", nil)

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, expectedErr, err)
	assert.False(t, isNew)
  assert.False(t, sendCalled, "send should not have been called on UpsertCred error")

	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
}

// Mock ExecuteTemplate for Reset Secret Success
var executedResetCode string
func mockExecuteTemplate_ResetSuccess(template *textt.Template, parts []string, params map[string]interface{}) (map[string]string, error) {
    code, okCode := params["Code"].(string)
    host, okHost := params["HostUrl"].(string)
     if !okCode || !okHost {
      return nil, errors.New("missing params in ExecuteTemplate mock")
    }
    executedResetCode = code
    return map[string]string{"": "Reset Code: " + code + ", Host: " + host}, nil
}

func TestValidatorResetSecret_Success_333(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	v := &validator{
		HostUrl: "http://reset.host",
	}
	// Setup default template
	defaultTmpl, _ := textt.New("default").Parse("Reset Code: {{.Code}}, Host: {{.HostUrl}}")
	v.universalTempl = []*textt.Template{defaultTmpl}

	phone := "tel:+15556667777"
	scheme := "basic" // Not used by tel validator, but part of signature
	lang := "en"      // Use default template
	code := []byte("reset_code_ABC")
	params := map[string]interface{}{} // Not used by tel validator

  // Patch validate ExecuteTemplate
  oldExecuteTemplate := validate.ExecuteTemplate
  validate.ExecuteTemplate = mockExecuteTemplate_ResetSuccess
  executedResetCode = "" // Reset capture
  defer func() { validate.ExecuteTemplate = oldExecuteTemplate }()

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1) // Expect send to be called once

  // Mock the internal send method
  var sendCalled bool
  var sentTo, sentBody string
  originalSend := v.send
  v.send = func(to, body string) error {
    sendCalled = true
    sentTo = to
    sentBody = body
    wg.Done()
    return nil
  }
  defer func() { v.send = originalSend }()

	// Act
	err := v.ResetSecret(phone, scheme, lang, code, params)

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)

  // Wait for send and check parameters
	wg.Wait()
	assert.True(t, sendCalled, "v.send should have been called")
	assert.Equal(t, phone, sentTo)
  require.Equal(t, string(code), executedResetCode, "Code passed to template mismatch")
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Reset Code: "+string(code)), "Sent body content mismatch (Code)")
  assert.True(t, strings.Contains(sentBody, "Host: "+v.HostUrl), "Sent body content mismatch (Host)")
}

// Helper function to setup store mocks correctly
func setupStoreMocks_CheckNotFound(t *testing.T) (*storeMocks.UsersStorage, func()) {
	mockStore := new(storeMocks.UsersStorage)
	originalStoreUsers := store.Users
	store.Users = mockStore
	return mockStore, func() {
		store.Users = originalStoreUsers
	}
}

func TestValidatorCheck_CredNotFound_404(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_CheckNotFound(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{}
	uid := types.ParseUid("usrChkNotFound")

	mockStore.On("GetActiveCred", uid, validatorName).Return(nil, nil).Once() // Credential is nil, error is nil

	// Act
	value, err := v.Check(uid, "any_response")

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, types.ErrNotFound, err) // Expect ErrNotFound
	assert.Empty(t, value)
	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
  mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "FailCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
  mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "ConfirmCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
}

func TestValidatorCheck_RetryLimitExceeded_414(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_CheckRetry(t)
	defer cleanup()

	maxRetries := 3
	v := &validator{MaxRetries: maxRetries}
	uid := types.ParseUid("usrChkRetry")

	cred := &types.Credential{
		User:    uid.String(),
		Method:  validatorName,
		Retries: maxRetries + 1, // Exceeded limit
	}

	mockStore.On("GetActiveCred", uid, validatorName).Return(cred, nil).Once()

	// Act
	value, err := v.Check(uid, "any_response")

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, types.ErrPolicy, err) // Expect policy error
	assert.Empty(t, value)
	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
	// Ensure FailCred or ConfirmCred were NOT called
	mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "FailCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
	mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "ConfirmCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
}

func TestValidatorCheck_ConfirmCredError_434(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_CheckConfirmErr(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{MaxRetries: 3}
	uid := types.ParseUid("usrChkConfErr")
	validResponse := "123456"
	expectedValue := "tel:+17778889999"
	expectedErr := errors.New("confirm failed in DB")

	cred := &types.Credential{
		User:   uid.String(),
		Method: validatorName,
		Value:  expectedValue,
		Resp:   validResponse, // Valid response
		Done:   false,
		Retries: 0,
	}

	mockStore.On("GetActiveCred", uid, validatorName).Return(cred, nil).Once()
	mockStore.On("ConfirmCred", uid, validatorName).Return(expectedErr).Once() // Simulate error during confirmation

	// Act
	value, err := v.Check(uid, validResponse)

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
  // Check returns the error from ConfirmCred directly
  assert.Equal(t, expectedErr, err)
	assert.Empty(t, value, "Value should be empty on confirmation error")
	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
  mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "FailCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
}

func TestValidatorCheck_FailCredIgnoredError_444(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
  mockStore, cleanup := setupStoreMocks_CheckFailErrIgnored(t)
	defer cleanup()

	v := &validator{MaxRetries: 3}
	uid := types.ParseUid("usrChkFailErrIgn")
	invalidResponse := "wrong_code"
  failCredErr := errors.New("FailCred DB error - ignored")

	cred := &types.Credential{
		User:   uid.String(),
		Method: validatorName,
		Resp:   "correct_code",
		Retries: 1,
	}

	mockStore.On("GetActiveCred", uid, validatorName).Return(cred, nil).Once()
	// FailCred is called, but its error is ignored by the implementation
  mockStore.On("FailCred", uid, validatorName).Return(failCredErr).Once()

	// Act
	value, err := v.Check(uid, invalidResponse)

	// Assert
	require.Error(t, err)
  // The function should still return ErrCredentials despite FailCred error
	assert.Equal(t, types.ErrCredentials, err)
	assert.Empty(t, value)
	mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
  mockStore.AssertNotCalled(t, "ConfirmCred", mock.Anything, mock.Anything)
}

func TestStatsInit_ValidPath_001(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    path := "/stats"
    mockTimeFunc := func() time.Time {
        return time.Unix(0, 0)
    }

    // Act
    statsInit(mux, path, mockTimeFunc)

    // Assert
    require.NotNil(t, globals.statsUpdate)
    assert.Equal(t, 1024, cap(globals.statsUpdate))

    // Check if the handler is registered
    req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", path, nil)
    require.NoError(t, err)

    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
    mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, req)

    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
}

    var logOutput strings.Builder
    log.SetOutput(&logOutput) // Capture log output

    // --- Mock Store expectations ---
    confJson := json.RawMessage(`{}`)
    mockStore.On("Open", 1, confJson).Return(nil) // Assume DB exists and version is OK
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterName").Return("mockdb")
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterVersion").Return(1)
    // GetDbVersion / IsOpen might not be called if Open returns nil without specific errors
    mockStore.On("GetDbVersion").Return(1).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("IsOpen").Return(true).Maybe()
    // Expect InitDb with drop=true due to --reset flag
    mockStore.On("InitDb", confJson, true).Return(nil)
    // Mock GetUidString maybe called by genDb inside the reset path
    mockStore.On("GetUidString").Return("dummyuid").Maybe()

    // --- Test execution ---
    os.Args = []string{"tinode-db", "--config=./tinode.conf", "--reset"}
    flag.CommandLine = flag.NewFlagSet(os.Args[0], flag.ExitOnError) // Use ExitOnError as success is expected

    // Expect main to panic due to mocked os.Exit(0)
    assert.PanicsWithValue(t, "os.Exit called with code 0", func() {
        main()
    }, "main should panic due to mocked os.Exit(0)")

    // --- Assertions ---
    mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)

    // Check log output for expected messages
    logStr := logOutput.String()
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Database adapter: 'mockdb'; version: 1")
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Reset requested. Dropping and recreating the database.")
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Database successfully reset.")
    // genDb is called after successful reset
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Generating sample database")
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "All done.")
}

    log.SetOutput(&logOutput)

    rootPassword := "securepass123"
    rootArg := rootUname + ":" + rootPassword
    expectedPassBytes := []byte(rootUname + ":" + rootPassword)
    // Use a predictable UID based on mocked GetUidString

    mockGeneratedUID := types.ParseUserId("usr" + uidString)
    require.False(t, mockGeneratedUID.IsZero(), "Failed to create mock UID")

    mockStore.On("Open", 1, confJson).Return(nil)
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterName").Return("mockdb")
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterVersion").Return(1)
    mockStore.On("GetDbVersion").Return(1).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("IsOpen").Return(true).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("GetAuthHandler", "basic").Return(mockAuthHandler)
    mockStore.On("GetUidString").Return(uidString) // Mock UID generation

    // Expect Users.Create call and simulate success by setting UID

        user.ObjHeader.SetUid(mockGeneratedUID)
        // Check Public data is set correctly before returning
        require.NotNil(t, user.Public)
        // Type assertion for theCard (assuming it's defined in main.go)
        cardData, ok := user.Public.(*theCard) // Correct type
        require.True(t, ok, "Public data should be of type *theCard")
        assert.Equal(t, "ROOT "+rootUname, cardData.Fn)
    }).Return(&types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: mockGeneratedUID.String()}}, nil)

    // Expect AddRecord with the generated user's UID
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(rec *auth.Rec) bool {
        return rec.Uid == mockGeneratedUID && rec.AuthLevel == auth.LevelRoot
    }), expectedPassBytes, "").Return(&auth.Rec{Uid: mockGeneratedUID}, nil)

    // --- Test execution ---
    os.Args = []string{"tinode-db", "--config=./tinode.conf", "--add_root=" + rootArg}
    flag.CommandLine = flag.NewFlagSet(os.Args[0], flag.ExitOnError)

    assert.PanicsWithValue(t, "os.Exit called with code 0", func() {
        main()
    })

    // --- Assertions ---
    mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockUsers.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockAuthHandler.AssertExpectations(t)

    logStr := logOutput.String()
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Database exists, version is correct.")
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, fmt.Sprintf("ROOT user created: '%s:%s'", rootUname, rootPassword))
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "All done.")
}

func TestMain_AddRoot_AddAuthFail_555(t *testing.T) {

    var logOutput strings.Builder
    log.SetOutput(&logOutput)

    // --- Mock Store/Users/Auth expectations ---
    confJson := json.RawMessage(`{}`)
    rootUname := "rootauthfail"
    rootPassword := "pass2"
    rootArg := rootUname + ":" + rootPassword
    expectedPassBytes := []byte(rootUname + ":" + rootPassword)
    uidString := "AuthFailUID1"
    mockGeneratedUID := types.ParseUserId("usr" + uidString)
    require.False(t, mockGeneratedUID.IsZero())
    addAuthErr := errors.New("auth scheme conflict")

    mockStore.On("Open", 1, confJson).Return(nil)
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterName").Return("mockdb")
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterVersion").Return(1)
    mockStore.On("GetDbVersion").Return(1).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("IsOpen").Return(true).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("GetAuthHandler", "basic").Return(mockAuthHandler)
    mockStore.On("GetUidString").Return(uidString)

    // Expect Users.Create call to succeed
    createdUserData := &types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: mockGeneratedUID.String()}}
    // Simulate UID assignment within the mock run function
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.AnythingOfType("*types.User"), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) {
    	user := args.Get(0).(*types.User)

    }).Return(createdUserData, nil)

    // Expect AddRecord to fail
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(rec *auth.Rec) bool {
        return rec.Uid == mockGeneratedUID && rec.AuthLevel == auth.LevelRoot
    }), expectedPassBytes, "").Return(nil, addAuthErr)

    // Expect Users.Delete to be called as cleanup after AddRecord fails (line 350)
    mockUsers.On("Delete", mockGeneratedUID, true).Return(nil) // Expect hard delete

    // --- Test execution ---
    os.Args = []string{"tinode-db", "--config=./tinode.conf", "--add_root=" + rootArg}
    flag.CommandLine = flag.NewFlagSet(os.Args[0], flag.ContinueOnError)

    assert.PanicsWithValue(t, "log.Fatalln called", func() {
        main()
    }, "main should panic due to mocked log.Fatalln")

    // --- Assertions ---
    mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockUsers.AssertExpectations(t) // Create and Delete called
    mockAuthHandler.AssertExpectations(t) // AddRecord called

    logStr := logOutput.String()
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Mock log.Fatalln:")
    // Check the specific fatal message (line 351)
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Failed to add ROOT auth record:")
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, addAuthErr.Error())

func TestMain_AddRootDefaultPassword_666(t *testing.T) {
    mockStore, mockUsers, _, mockAuthHandler := setupTest(t)
    var logOutput strings.Builder
    log.SetOutput(&logOutput)

    // Mock crand.Read for predictable password generation
    originalCrandRead := crandRead // Backup original from setup
    crandRead = func(b []byte) (n int, err error) {
        // Fill buffer with predictable bytes (e.g., 'a', 'b', 'c'...)
        // Ensure we fill the exact length requested (10 in getPassword)
        if len(b) != 10 {
             return 0, errors.New("unexpected buffer length in mock crand.Read")
        }
        copy(b, []byte("abcdefghij")) // Corresponds to letters[0] to letters[9]
        return len(b), nil
    }
    // Restore original crandRead after test using t.Cleanup from setupTest
    t.Cleanup(func() { crandRead = originalCrandRead })


    // --- Mock Store/Users/Auth expectations ---
    confJson := json.RawMessage(`{}`)
    rootUname := "defaultpassroot"
    rootArg := rootUname // No password specified
    // Password generated by getPassword(10) using mocked crandRead("abcdefghij")
    // Indices: 0..9 -> letters[0..9] -> "abcdefghij"
    expectedPassword := "abcdefghij"
    expectedPassBytes := []byte(rootUname + ":" + expectedPassword)
    uidString := "DefPassUID1"
    mockGeneratedUID := types.ParseUserId("usr" + uidString)
    require.False(t, mockGeneratedUID.IsZero())

    mockStore.On("Open", 1, confJson).Return(nil)
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterName").Return("mockdb")
    mockStore.On("GetAdapterVersion").Return(1)
    mockStore.On("GetDbVersion").Return(1).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("IsOpen").Return(true).Maybe()
    mockStore.On("GetAuthHandler", "basic").Return(mockAuthHandler)
    mockStore.On("GetUidString").Return(uidString)

    // Expect Users.Create call to succeed
    createdUserData := &types.User{ObjHeader: types.ObjHeader{Id: mockGeneratedUID.String()}}
    mockUsers.On("Create", mock.AnythingOfType("*types.User"), mock.Anything).Run(func(args mock.Arguments) {
        user := args.Get(0).(*types.User)
        user.ObjHeader.SetUid(mockGeneratedUID)
    }).Return(createdUserData, nil)

    // Expect AddRecord with the generated password
    mockAuthHandler.On("AddRecord", mock.MatchedBy(func(rec *auth.Rec) bool {
        return rec.Uid == mockGeneratedUID && rec.AuthLevel == auth.LevelRoot
    }), expectedPassBytes, "").Return(&auth.Rec{Uid: mockGeneratedUID}, nil)

    // --- Test execution ---
    os.Args = []string{"tinode-db", "--config=./tinode.conf", "--add_root=" + rootArg}
    flag.CommandLine = flag.NewFlagSet(os.Args[0], flag.ExitOnError)

    assert.PanicsWithValue(t, "os.Exit called with code 0", func() {
        main()
    })

    // --- Assertions ---
    mockStore.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockUsers.AssertExpectations(t)
    mockAuthHandler.AssertExpectations(t)

    logStr := logOutput.String()
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "Database exists, version is correct.")
    // Check log for generated password (line 353)
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, fmt.Sprintf("ROOT user created: '%s:%s'", rootUname, expectedPassword))
    assert.Contains(t, logStr, "All done.")
}

func TestPayloadToData_ValidMsgPayload_123(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	timestamp := time.Now()
	// Simple plain text content, assuming drafty functions work correctly.
	// For more complex Drafty content, integration tests would be needed.
	longContent := ""
	for i := 0; i < push.MaxPayloadLength+10; i++ {
		longContent += "a"
	}

	payload := &push.Payload{
		What:        push.ActMsg,
		Silent:      true,
		Topic:       "test_topic",
		Timestamp:   timestamp,
		From:        "usr123",
		SeqId:       42,
		ContentType: "text/plain",
		Content:     longContent, // Use plain string for simplicity assuming Drafty handles it
		Webrtc:      "started",
		AudioOnly:   true,
		Replace:     "seq123",
	}

	expectedContentPreview := string([]rune(longContent)[:push.MaxPayloadLength]) + "…"

	// Act
	data, err := payloadToData(payload)

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, data)
	assert.Equal(t, push.ActMsg, data["what"])
	// Note: Webrtc and Replace make the push silent implicitly
	assert.Equal(t, "true", data["silent"])
	assert.Equal(t, "test_topic", data["topic"])
	assert.Equal(t, timestamp.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), data["ts"])
	assert.Equal(t, "usr123", data["xfrom"])
	assert.Equal(t, "42", data["seq"])
	assert.Equal(t, "text/plain", data["mime"])
	// Assuming drafty.PlainText just returns the string here and drafty.Preview does the same + trimming
	assert.Equal(t, expectedContentPreview, data["content"])
	assert.NotEmpty(t, data["rc"]) // Exact Drafty JSON is complex to predict/assert here
	assert.Equal(t, "started", data["webrtc"])
	assert.Equal(t, "true", data["aonly"])
	assert.Equal(t, "seq123", data["replace"])
}

func TestPayloadToData_SubscriptionAction_789(t *testing.T) {
	// Arrange
	timestamp := time.Now()
	payload := &push.Payload{
		What:      push.ActSub,
		Silent:    false,
		Topic:     "grp123",
		Timestamp: timestamp,
		From:      "sys",
		ModeWant:  types.ModeCSRead | types.ModeCSWrite, // Use types alias
		ModeGiven: types.ModeCSRead,                   // Use types alias
	}

	// Act
	data, err := payloadToData(payload)

	// Assert
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, data)
	assert.Equal(t, push.ActSub, data["what"])

	assert.Equal(t, types.ModeCSRead.String(), data["modeGiven"])
	_, silent := data["silent"]
	assert.False(t, silent) // Should not be silent by default
}

func TestPrepareV1Notifications_SkipDevice_202(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    mockDevices := new(storeMocks.DevicesAccessor)
    originalDevices := store.Devices
    store.Devices = mockDevices
    defer func() { store.Devices = originalDevices }()

    uid1 := types.ParseUid("usr111")
    onlineDeviceID := "ios_token_online"
    offlineDeviceID := "ios_token_offline"

    rcpt := &push.Receipt{
        To: map[types.Uid]push.Recipient{
            uid1: {Unread: 5, Delivered: 1, Devices: []string{onlineDeviceID}}, // Mark one device as having received
        },
        Payload: push.Payload{
            What:      push.ActMsg,
            Topic:     "grp123",
            Timestamp: time.Now(),
            From:      "usr222",
            SeqId:     1,
            Content:   "hello",
        },
    }
    config := &configType{
        TimeToLive: 3600,
        Apns:       &common.Config{Enabled: true},
        ApnsBundleID: "test.bundle.id",
    }

    // Store has two devices, one online, one offline
    devices := map[types.Uid][]types.DeviceDef{
        uid1: {
            {DeviceId: onlineDeviceID, Platform: "ios"},
            {DeviceId: offlineDeviceID, Platform: "ios"},
        },
    }
    mockDevices.On("GetAll", []types.Uid{uid1}).Return(devices, 2, nil)

    // Act
    messages, uids := PrepareV1Notifications(rcpt, config)

    // Assert
    require.NoError(t, mockDevices.AssertExpectations(t))
    require.Len(t, messages, 1) // Only the offline device should get a push
    require.Len(t, uids, 1)
    assert.Equal(t, uid1, uids[0])

    msg := messages[0]
    assert.Equal(t, offlineDeviceID, msg.Token) // Push sent to offline device
    assert.NotNil(t, msg.Apns)
    assert.Nil(t, msg.Android)
    // Check if it was silenced due to Delivered > 0
    assert.Equal(t, "true", msg.Data["silent"])

    // Verify APNS payload specifics for silent push (like no alert)
    var payload map[string]interface{}
    err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Apns.Payload, &payload)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    aps, ok := payload["aps"].(map[string]interface{})
    require.True(t, ok)
    _, alertPresent := aps["alert"]
    assert.False(t, alertPresent, "Silent push should not have 'alert' field")
    assert.Equal(t, float64(1), aps["content-available"]) // Should still have content-available
    assert.Equal(t, float64(5), aps["badge"]) // Badge should still be sent
}

func TestPrepareV1Notifications_P2P_203(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    mockDevices := new(storeMocks.DevicesAccessor)
    originalDevices := store.Devices
    store.Devices = mockDevices
    defer func() { store.Devices = originalDevices }()

    uid1 := types.ParseUid("usr111")
    uid2 := types.ParseUid("usr222") // Sender
    p2pTopic := uid1.P2PName(uid2)    // Original P2P topic name

    rcpt := &push.Receipt{
        To: map[types.Uid]push.Recipient{
            uid1: {Unread: 1}, // Recipient is uid1
        },
        Payload: push.Payload{
            What:      push.ActMsg,
            Topic:     p2pTopic, // P2P topic name
            Timestamp: time.Now(),
            From:      uid2.UserId(), // Sender is uid2
            SeqId:     5,
            Content:   "p2p message",
        },
    }
    config := &configType{
        Apns: &common.Config{Enabled: true},
        ApnsBundleID: "test.bundle.id",
    }

    devices := map[types.Uid][]types.DeviceDef{
        uid1: {{DeviceId: "p2p_token", Platform: "ios"}},
    }
    mockDevices.On("GetAll", []types.Uid{uid1}).Return(devices, 1, nil)

    // Act
    messages, uids := PrepareV1Notifications(rcpt, config)

    // Assert
    require.NoError(t, mockDevices.AssertExpectations(t))
    require.Len(t, messages, 1)
    require.Len(t, uids, 1)
    assert.Equal(t, uid1, uids[0])

    msg := messages[0]
    assert.Equal(t, "p2p_token", msg.Token)
    require.NotNil(t, msg.Data)
    // Verify the topic name in the data payload is adjusted for the recipient (uid1)
    expectedTopicForUid1, err := types.P2PNameForUser(uid1, p2pTopic)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    assert.Equal(t, expectedTopicForUid1, msg.Data["topic"])
    assert.Equal(t, uid2.UserId(), msg.Data["xfrom"])

    // Verify APNS payload uses the adjusted topic name for thread-id and collapse-id
    require.NotNil(t, msg.Apns)
    require.NotNil(t, msg.Apns.Headers)
    assert.Equal(t, expectedTopicForUid1, msg.Apns.Headers[common.HeaderApnsCollapseID])
    var apsPayload map[string]interface{}
    err = json.Unmarshal(msg.Apns.Payload, &apsPayload)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    aps, _ := apsPayload["aps"].(map[string]interface{})
    assert.Equal(t, expectedTopicForUid1, aps["thread-id"])
}

        Apns:       &common.Config{Enabled: true, Payload: common.Payload{Title: "Channel"}},
        Webpush:    &common.Config{Enabled: true}, // Assuming Webpush config struct exists
        ApnsBundleID: "test.bundle.id",
    }


    // Act
    messages, uids := PrepareV1Notifications(rcpt, config)

    // Assert
    require.Len(t, messages, 1) // One message for the channel topic
    require.Len(t, uids, 1)
    assert.Equal(t, types.ZeroUid, uids[0]) // Placeholder UID for channel push

    msg := messages[0]
    assert.Empty(t, msg.Token)         // No token for channel push
    assert.Equal(t, channelName, msg.Topic) // Message topic is the channel name
    require.NotNil(t, msg.Data)
    assert.Equal(t, channelName, msg.Data["topic"]) // Data topic is also the channel name
    _, fromPresent := msg.Data["xfrom"]
    assert.False(t, fromPresent, "'xfrom' should be removed for channel pushes")
    assert.Equal(t, "10", msg.Data["seq"])
    assert.Equal(t, "channel message", msg.Data["content"])

    // Check that payloads for all enabled platforms are present
    assert.NotNil(t, msg.Android)
    assert.NotNil(t, msg.Apns)
    assert.NotNil(t, msg.Webpush) // Check if webpush config is added

    // Check specific platform details
    assert.Equal(t, channelName, msg.Android.Notification.Tag)
    assert.Equal(t, channelName, msg.Apns.Headers[common.HeaderApnsCollapseID])
    var apsPayload map[string]interface{}
    err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Apns.Payload, &apsPayload)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    aps, _ := apsPayload["aps"].(map[string]interface{})
    assert.Equal(t, channelName, aps["thread-id"])
}

import (

  storeMocks "github.com/tinode/chat/mocks/server/store"
  fcmv1 "google.golang.org/api/fcm/v1"
)

Required Library Installation
go get github.com/stretchr/testify/assert
go get github.com/stretchr/testify/require
go get github.com/stretchr/testify/mock
go get google.golang.org/api/fcm/v1

Test Implementation:
func TestPrepareV1Notifications_NilConfig_210(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    mockDevices := new(storeMocks.DevicesAccessor)
    originalDevices := store.Devices
    store.Devices = mockDevices
    defer func() { store.Devices = originalDevices }()

    uid1 := types.ParseUid("usr111")
    rcpt := &push.Receipt{
        To: map[types.Uid]push.Recipient{
            uid1: {Unread: 5, Delivered: 0},
        },
        Payload: push.Payload{
            What:      push.ActMsg,
            Topic:     "grp123",
            Timestamp: time.Now(),
            From:      "usr222",
            SeqId:     1,
            Content:   "hello",
        },
    }
    // config is nil
    var config *configType = nil

    devices := map[types.Uid][]types.DeviceDef{
        uid1: {
            {DeviceId: "android_token_1", Platform: "android"},
            {DeviceId: "ios_token_1", Platform: "ios"},
            {DeviceId: "web_token_1", Platform: "web"}, // Web requires config for Webpush field
            {DeviceId: "unknown_token_1", Platform: "unknown"},
            {DeviceId: "empty_token_1", Platform: ""},
         },
    }
    mockDevices.On("GetAll", []types.Uid{uid1}).Return(devices, 5, nil)

    // Act
    messages, uids := PrepareV1Notifications(rcpt, config)

    // Assert
    require.NoError(t, mockDevices.AssertExpectations(t))
    require.Len(t, messages, 5) // One message per device token
    require.Len(t, uids, 5)

    // Check platforms were handled gracefully with nil config
    for _, msg := range messages {
        switch msg.Token {
        case "android_token_1":
            assert.NotNil(t, msg.Android)
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Android.Notification) // Notification part requires config.Android.Enabled
            assert.Equal(t, strconv.Itoa(defaultTimeToLive)+"s", msg.Android.Ttl)
        case "ios_token_1":
            assert.NotNil(t, msg.Apns)
            assert.NotNil(t, msg.Apns.Headers)
            assert.NotEmpty(t, msg.Apns.Payload) // Basic APS payload is always generated
            var payload map[string]interface{}
            err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Apns.Payload, &payload)
            require.NoError(t, err)
            aps, ok := payload["aps"].(map[string]interface{})
            require.True(t, ok)
            _, alertPresent := aps["alert"]
            // Alert should not be present because config.Apns is nil (checked inside apnsShouldPresentAlert)
            assert.False(t, alertPresent, "Alert should not be present with nil config")
        case "web_token_1":
            // Webpush field is only added if config.Webpush.Enabled is true
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Webpush)
        case "unknown_token_1": // Should have base message, no platform specifics
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Android)
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Apns)
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Webpush)
        case "empty_token_1": // Should have base message, no platform specifics
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Android)
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Apns)
            assert.Nil(t, msg.Webpush)
        }
        assert.NotNil(t, msg.Data) // Data should always be present
    }
}

func TestAndroidNotificationConfig_Msg_501(t *testing.T) {

    what := push.ActMsg
    topic := "grp123"
    data := map[string]string{"content": "message content"}
    config := &configType{
        TimeToLive: 7200,
        Android: &common.Config{
            Enabled: true,
            Payload: common.Payload{
                Title:       "New Message",
                Body:        "$content", // Use content from data
                Icon:        "msg_icon",
                Color:       "#FF0000",
                ClickAction: "OPEN_CHAT",
            },
        },
    }

    // Act

    // Assert

    assert.Equal(t, string(common.AndroidPriorityHigh), ac.Priority)
    assert.Equal(t, "7200s", ac.Ttl)
    require.NotNil(t, ac.Notification)
    assert.Equal(t, topic, ac.Notification.Tag)
    assert.Equal(t, string(common.AndroidNotificationPriorityHigh), ac.Notification.NotificationPriority)
    assert.Equal(t, string(common.AndroidVisibilityPrivate), ac.Notification.Visibility)
    assert.Equal(t, "New Message", ac.Notification.Title)
    assert.Equal(t, "message content", ac.Notification.Body) // Check $content replacement
    assert.Equal(t, "msg_icon", ac.Notification.Icon)
    assert.Equal(t, "#FF0000", ac.Notification.Color)
    assert.Equal(t, "OPEN_CHAT", ac.Notification.ClickAction)
}

Test Implementation:
func TestApnsShouldPresentAlert_Various_601(t *testing.T) {
    configEnabled := &configType{Apns: &common.Config{Enabled: true}}
    configDisabled := &configType{Apns: &common.Config{Enabled: false}}
    configNil := &configType{Apns: nil}

    testCases := []struct {
        name       string
        what       string
        callStatus string
        isSilent   string
        config     *configType
        expected   bool
    }{
        {"Enabled Msg", push.ActMsg, "", "", configEnabled, true},
        {"Enabled Sub", push.ActSub, "", "", configEnabled, true},
        {"Enabled Read", push.ActRead, "", "", configEnabled, false}, // Read never alerts
        {"Enabled Call", push.ActMsg, "started", "", configEnabled, false}, // Call never alerts
        {"Enabled Silent", push.ActMsg, "", "true", configEnabled, false}, // Silent never alerts
        {"Disabled Msg", push.ActMsg, "", "", configDisabled, false}, // Disabled never alerts
        {"Nil Config Msg", push.ActMsg, "", "", configNil, false},       // Nil config never alerts
        {"Nil Config Type", push.ActMsg, "", "", nil, false},            // Nil config never alerts
    }

    for _, tc := range testCases {
        t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            actual := apnsShouldPresentAlert(tc.what, tc.callStatus, tc.isSilent, tc.config)
            assert.Equal(t, tc.expected, actual)
        })
    }
}

Test Implementation:
func TestApnsNotificationConfig_Msg_701(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    what := push.ActMsg
    topic := "grptopic"
    data := map[string]string{"content": "apns message"}
    unread := 3
    bundleId := "com.example.app"
    config := &configType{
        TimeToLive: 120,
        ApnsBundleID: bundleId,
        Apns: &common.Config{
            Enabled: true,
            Payload: common.Payload{
                Title:           "APNS Title",
                Subtitle:        "APNS Subtitle",
                Body:            "$content",
                ActionLocKey:    "REPLY_ACTION",
                SummaryArg:      "sender_name",
                SummaryArgCount: 1,
            },
        },
    }

    // Act
    ac := apnsNotificationConfig(what, topic, data, unread, config)

    // Assert
    require.NotNil(t, ac)
    require.NotNil(t, ac.Headers)
    require.NotNil(t, ac.Payload)

    // Check Headers
    assert.Equal(t, bundleId, ac.Headers[common.HeaderApnsTopic])
    assert.Equal(t, topic, ac.Headers[common.HeaderApnsCollapseID])
    assert.Equal(t, "10", ac.Headers[common.HeaderApnsPriority]) // Default high priority
    assert.Equal(t, string(common.ApnsPushTypeAlert), ac.Headers[common.HeaderApnsPushType])
    expiresStr := ac.Headers[common.HeaderApnsExpiration]
    expiresUnix, err := strconv.ParseInt(expiresStr, 10, 64)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    // Check expiration is roughly correct (within a few seconds)
    assert.InDelta(t, time.Now().UTC().Add(120*time.Second).Unix(), expiresUnix, 5)

    // Check Payload
    var payload map[string]interface{}
    err = json.Unmarshal(ac.Payload, &payload)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    aps, ok := payload["aps"].(map[string]interface{})
    require.True(t, ok)
    assert.Equal(t, float64(unread), aps["badge"])
    assert.Equal(t, float64(1), aps["content-available"])
    assert.Equal(t, float64(1), aps["mutable-content"])
    assert.Equal(t, string(common.InterruptionLevelTimeSensitive), aps["interruption-level"])
    assert.Equal(t, "default", aps["sound"])
    assert.Equal(t, topic, aps["thread-id"])

    alert, ok := aps["alert"].(map[string]interface{})
    require.True(t, ok, "Alert should be present")
    assert.Equal(t, "APNS Title", alert["title"])
    assert.Equal(t, "APNS Subtitle", alert["subtitle"])
    assert.Equal(t, "apns message", alert["body"]) // Check $content replacement
    assert.Equal(t, "REPLY_ACTION", alert["action-loc-key"])
    assert.Equal(t, "sender_name", alert["summary-arg"])
    assert.Equal(t, float64(1), alert["summary-arg-count"])
}

    }

    expiresUnix, err := strconv.ParseInt(expiresStr, 10, 64)

    require.True(t, ok)

    assert.Equal(t, float64(1), aps["content-available"])

Test Implementation:
func TestLargeFileServe_AuthChallenge_567(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
    defer ctrl.Finish()

    mockMediaHandler := storeMocks.NewMockMediaHandler(ctrl)
    mockStoreInstance := newMockStore(mockMediaHandler, nil, nil, nil, nil)
    store.Store = mockStoreInstance

    originalApiKeys := globals.apiKeys
    globals.apiKeys = map[string]string{"valid-key": "valid"}
    defer func() { globals.apiKeys = originalApiKeys }()

    challengeBytes := []byte("test-challenge")
    originalAuthHttpRequest := authHttpRequest
    authHttpRequest = func(req *http.Request) (types.Uid, []byte, error) {
        return types.ZeroUid, challengeBytes, nil // Return challenge
    }
    defer func() { authHttpRequest = originalAuthHttpRequest }()

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/files/somefile", nil)
    req.Header.Set("X-Tinode-APIKey", "valid-key")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileServe(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code) // Challenge is OK status
    body := recorder.Body.String()
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"code":200`)
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"text":"Authentication challenge"`)
    // Check if challenge is present (it's base64 encoded in JSON)
    encodedChallenge := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(challengeBytes)
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"params":{"challenge":"`+encodedChallenge+`"}`)
}

func TestLargeFileServe_MediaHandlerHeadersStatus_890(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
    defer ctrl.Finish()

    mockMediaHandler := storeMocks.NewMockMediaHandler(ctrl)
    mockStoreInstance := newMockStore(mockMediaHandler, nil, nil, nil, nil)
    store.Store = mockStoreInstance

    originalApiKeys := globals.apiKeys
    globals.apiKeys = map[string]string{"valid-key": "valid"}
    defer func() { globals.apiKeys = originalApiKeys }()

    testUID := types.ParseUserId("usrTest123")
    originalAuthHttpRequest := authHttpRequest
    authHttpRequest = func(req *http.Request) (types.Uid, []byte, error) {
        return testUID, nil, nil
    }
    defer func() { authHttpRequest = originalAuthHttpRequest }()

    redirectHeaders := http.Header{"Location": []string{"/elsewhere"}}
    mockMediaHandler.EXPECT().Headers(gomock.Any(), true).Return(redirectHeaders, http.StatusFound, nil) // 302 Found

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/files/somefile", nil)
    req.Header.Set("X-Tinode-APIKey", "valid-key")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileServe(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusFound, recorder.Code)
    assert.Equal(t, "/elsewhere", recorder.Header().Get("Location"))
    // Body should contain the status message for GET requests
    assert.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), http.StatusText(http.StatusFound))
}

func TestLargeFileServe_GetSuccessHTMLAttachment_123(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
    defer ctrl.Finish()

    mockMediaHandler := storeMocks.NewMockMediaHandler(ctrl)
    mockStoreInstance := newMockStore(mockMediaHandler, nil, nil, nil, nil)
    store.Store = mockStoreInstance

    originalApiKeys := globals.apiKeys
    globals.apiKeys = map[string]string{"valid-key": "valid"}
    defer func() { globals.apiKeys = originalApiKeys }()

    testUID := types.ParseUserId("usrTest123")
    originalAuthHttpRequest := authHttpRequest
    authHttpRequest = func(req *http.Request) (types.Uid, []byte, error) {
        return testUID, nil, nil
    }
    defer func() { authHttpRequest = originalAuthHttpRequest }()

    fileContent := "<html><body>test</body></html>"
    mockReadSeeker := newMockReadSeekCloser(strings.NewReader(fileContent))
    fileDef := &types.FileDef{
        MimeType: "text/html", // HTML mime type
        UpdatedAt: time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
    }

    mockMediaHandler.EXPECT().Headers(gomock.Any(), true).Return(http.Header{}, 0, nil)
    mockMediaHandler.EXPECT().Download(gomock.Eq("/files/somefile?q=1")).Return(fileDef, mockReadSeeker, nil)

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/files/somefile?q=1", nil)
    req.Header.Set("X-Tinode-APIKey", "valid-key")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileServe(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
    assert.Equal(t, "text/html", recorder.Header().Get("Content-Type"))
    assert.Equal(t, "attachment", recorder.Header().Get("Content-Disposition")) // Should be attachment for HTML
    assert.Equal(t, fileContent, recorder.Body.String())
    assert.True(t, mockReadSeeker.closed, "ReadSeekCloser should be closed")
}

Test Implementation:
func TestLargeFileReceive_PreflightOptionsSuccess_456(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
    defer ctrl.Finish()

    mockMediaHandler := storeMocks.NewMockMediaHandler(ctrl)
    mockStoreInstance := newMockStore(mockMediaHandler, nil, nil, nil, nil) // Pass nil for unused mocks
    store.Store = mockStoreInstance // Replace global store

    expectedHeaders := http.Header{"Access-Control-Allow-Methods": []string{"POST, PUT"}, "X-Upload-Limit": []string{"10MB"}}
    mockMediaHandler.EXPECT().Headers(gomock.Any(), false).Return(expectedHeaders, http.StatusNoContent, nil)

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodOptions, "/files/", nil)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileReceive(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, recorder.Code)
    assert.Equal(t, "POST, PUT", recorder.Header().Get("Access-Control-Allow-Methods"))
    assert.Equal(t, "10MB", recorder.Header().Get("X-Upload-Limit"))
}

import (
	"bytes"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

    "time" // Needed indirectly

	"github.com/golang/mock/gomock"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/tinode/chat/server/store"
	storeMocks "github.com/tinode/chat/mocks/server/store"
)
Test Implementation:
func TestLargeFileReceive_InvalidAPIKey_678(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
    defer ctrl.Finish()

    mockMediaHandler := storeMocks.NewMockMediaHandler(ctrl)
    mockStoreInstance := newMockStore(mockMediaHandler, nil, nil, nil, nil)
    store.Store = mockStoreInstance

    // Set expected API keys (empty in this case, so any key is invalid)
    originalApiKeys := globals.apiKeys
    globals.apiKeys = map[string]string{}
    defer func() { globals.apiKeys = originalApiKeys }()

    // Simulate a POST request with multipart form data
    body := new(bytes.Buffer)
    writer := multipart.NewWriter(body)
    _ = writer.WriteField("id", "msg123")
    part, _ := writer.CreateFormFile("file", "test.txt")
    _, _ = part.Write([]byte("file content"))
    writer.Close()

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/files/", body)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
    req.Header.Set("X-Tinode-APIKey", "invalid-key") // Provide an invalid key
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileReceive(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, recorder.Code)
    assert.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), "API key required") // Check specific error msg
}

        maxMessageSize: 10,
    }
    globals = mockGlobals

    mockSession := &Session{}
    wrt := httptest.NewRecorder()

        {
            name: "Only dWant is non-empty",
            params: presParams{
                dWant:  "RW",
                dGiven: "",
            },
            expected: &MsgAccessMode{Want: "RW", Given: ""},
        },
        {
            name: "Only dGiven is non-empty",
            params: presParams{
                dWant:  "",
                dGiven: "R",
            },
            expected: &MsgAccessMode{Want: "", Given: "R"},
        },
        {
            name: "Both dWant and dGiven are non-empty",
            params: presParams{
                dWant:  "RW",
                dGiven: "R",
            },
            expected: &MsgAccessMode{Want: "RW", Given: "R"},
        },
    }

    for _, tt := range tests {
        t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            result := tt.params.packAcs()
            if tt.expected == nil {
                assert.Nil(t, result)
            } else {
                assert.Equal(t, tt.expected.Want, result.Want)
                assert.Equal(t, tt.expected.Given, result.Given)
            }
        })
    }
}

import (
    "testing"
)

Required Library Installation
go get github.com/stretchr/testify

Test Implementation:
func TestStringSliceDelta_ValidInput_003(t *testing.T) {
    oldSlice := []string{"a", "b", "c"}
    newSlice := []string{"b", "c", "d"}

    expectedAdded := []string{"d"}
    expectedRemoved := []string{"a"}
    expectedIntersection := []string{"b", "c"}

    added, removed, intersection := stringSliceDelta(oldSlice, newSlice)

    if !slicesEqual(expectedAdded, added) {
        t.Errorf("Added: expected %+v, got %+v", expectedAdded, added)
    }
    if !slicesEqual(expectedRemoved, removed) {
        t.Errorf("Removed: expected %+v, got %+v", expectedRemoved, removed)
    }
    if !slicesEqual(expectedIntersection, intersection) {
        t.Errorf("Intersection: expected %+v, got %+v", expectedIntersection, intersection)
    }
}

        {Method: "phone", Value: "1234567890"},
        {Method: "unknown", Value: "value"},
    }
    expected := []MsgCredClient{
        {Method: "email", Value: "test@example.com"},
        {Method: "phone", Value: "1234567890"},
    }

    result := normalizeCredentials(input, true)

    if len(result) != len(expected) {
        t.Errorf("Expected length %d, got %d", len(expected), len(result))
    }

    for i, cred := range result {
        if cred.Method != expected[i].Method || cred.Value != expected[i].Value {
            t.Errorf("Expected %+v, got %+v", expected[i], cred)
        }
    }
}

Test Implementation:
func TestStatsInit_ValidPath_901(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    path := "/customstats"
    originalStatsUpdate := globals.statsUpdate // Save original state

    // Act
    statsInit(mux, path)
    // Need to shutdown the updater started by statsInit to avoid race conditions in other tests
    if globals.statsUpdate != nil {
         globals.statsUpdate <- nil // Signal shutdown
         time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) // Allow time for shutdown
    }

    // Assert
    require.NotNil(t, globals.statsUpdate, "globals.statsUpdate should be initialized")
    assert.Equal(t, 1024, cap(globals.statsUpdate), "globals.statsUpdate should have capacity 1024")

    // Check if the handler is registered
    req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", path, nil)
    require.NoError(t, err)

    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
    mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, req)

    // Should return OK, but the content check requires the server to be running.
    // expvar.Handler() itself works, so checking registration is sufficient here.
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)

    // Check if default expvars are published
    assert.NotNil(t, expvar.Get("Uptime"))
    assert.NotNil(t, expvar.Get("NumGoroutines"))
    // Check the value of NumGoroutines (will vary, but should be > 0)
    numGoroutinesVar := expvar.Get("NumGoroutines").(expvar.Func)
    assert.True(t, numGoroutinesVar().(int) > 0)
    // Check Uptime (will be close to 0 but positive)
    uptimeVar := expvar.Get("Uptime").(expvar.Func)
    assert.True(t, uptimeVar().(float64) >= 0)


    // Restore original state
    globals.statsUpdate = originalStatsUpdate
    // Explicitly unpublish vars to prevent interference with other tests
    expvar.Get("Uptime").(expvar.Func)() // Call to avoid "assigned but not used"
    expvar.Get("NumGoroutines").(expvar.Func)()
    // Note: There's no direct expvar.Unpublish. Best practice is often restarting for clean state or using unique names per test.
    // Since expvar uses a global map, we can try setting them to nil, though not ideal.
    expvar.Publish("Uptime", nil)
    expvar.Publish("NumGoroutines", nil)
}

func TestStatsSet_Success_711(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    originalStatsUpdate := globals.statsUpdate
    globals.statsUpdate = make(chan *varUpdate, 1) // Use buffered channel of size 1
    defer func() { globals.statsUpdate = originalStatsUpdate }() // Cleanup

    name := "TestSetVar"
    val := int64(99)

    // Act
    statsSet(name, val)

    // Assert
    select {
    case upd := <-globals.statsUpdate:
        require.NotNil(t, upd)
        assert.Equal(t, name, upd.varname)
        assert.Equal(t, val, upd.value)
        assert.False(t, upd.inc)
    case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
        t.Fatal("Did not receive update on channel")
    }
}

Test Implementation:
func TestStatsUpdater_AllOperations_758(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    originalStatsUpdate := globals.statsUpdate
    globals.statsUpdate = make(chan *varUpdate, 10) // Buffered channel for updates
    defer func() { globals.statsUpdate = originalStatsUpdate }()

    // Register variables for testing
    intVarName := "UpdaterIntVar"
    histVarName := "UpdaterHistVar"
    bounds := []float64{5.0, 15.0}
    statsRegisterInt(intVarName)
    statsRegisterHistogram(histVarName, bounds)

    // Start the updater in a goroutine
    updaterDone := make(chan bool)
    go func() {
        statsUpdater()
        close(updaterDone)
    }()

    // Send updates
    statsSet(intVarName, 100)
    statsInc(intVarName, 50)        // 100 + 50 = 150
    statsInc(intVarName, -25)       // 150 - 25 = 125
    statsAddHistSample(histVarName, 3.0) // Bucket 0
    statsAddHistSample(histVarName, 7.0) // Bucket 1
    statsAddHistSample(histVarName, 20.0)// Bucket 2

    // Send shutdown signal
    statsShutdown()

    // Wait for updater to finish
    select {
    case <-updaterDone:
        // Updater finished cleanly
    case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond): // Increased timeout
        t.Fatal("statsUpdater did not shut down")
    }

    // Assert Int variable state
    intEv := expvar.Get(intVarName)
    require.NotNil(t, intEv)
    intVar, ok := intEv.(*expvar.Int)
    require.True(t, ok)
    assert.Equal(t, int64(125), intVar.Value())

    // Assert Histogram variable state
    histEv := expvar.Get(histVarName)
    require.NotNil(t, histEv)
    histVar, ok := histEv.(*histogram)
    require.True(t, ok)
    assert.Equal(t, int64(3), histVar.Count)
    assert.Equal(t, 3.0+7.0+20.0, histVar.Sum)
    assert.Equal(t, []int64{1, 1, 1}, histVar.CountPerBucket)

    // Assert channel is now nil (due to shutdown)
    assert.Nil(t, globals.statsUpdate)

    // Cleanup expvars
    expvar.Publish(intVarName, nil)
    expvar.Publish(histVarName, nil)
}

func TestStatsUpdater_UnknownVariablePanic_119(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    originalStatsUpdate := globals.statsUpdate
    globals.statsUpdate = make(chan *varUpdate, 1)
    // No defer for cleanup here, panic should stop execution

    // Send an update for a variable that doesn't exist
    unknownVarName := "IAmNotRegistered"
    globals.statsUpdate <- &varUpdate{varname: unknownVarName, value: int64(1), inc: false}
    close(globals.statsUpdate) // Close channel so range loop exits after panic or processing

    // Act & Assert
    assert.PanicsWithValue(t, "stats: update to unknown variable "+unknownVarName, func() {
        statsUpdater()
    }, "Should panic when updating an unknown variable")

    // Cleanup (restore channel state in case panic is caught differently)
    globals.statsUpdate = originalStatsUpdate
}

    mockSessionStore.On("NewSession", mockStream, "").Return(mockSession, 1)

    mockStream.On("Context").Return(context.WithValue(context.Background(), "peer", &peer.Peer{Addr: &net.IPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1")}}))
    mockStream.On("Recv").Return(&pbx.ClientMsg{}, nil).Once()
    mockStream.On("Recv").Return(nil, io.EOF).Once()

    // Act
    grpcServer := &grpcNodeServer{}
    err := grpcServer.MessageLoop(mockStream)

    // Assert
    require.NoError(t, err)
    mockSessionStore.AssertCalled(t, "NewSession", mockStream, "")
    mockStream.AssertCalled(t, "Recv")
    mockStream.AssertCalled(t, "Context")
}

func TestHandler_Push_ReturnsChannel_777(t *testing.T) {
    resetHandler()
    // Arrange
    // Minimal setup: only the input channel is needed to test Push()
    testChan := make(chan *push.Receipt, 1)
    handler.input = testChan

    // Act
    ch := handler.Push()

    // Assert
    assert.NotNil(t, ch)
    assert.Equal(t, testChan, ch) // Check if it returns the same channel instance

    // Optional: Verify channel works (simple send/receive)
    rcpt := &push.Receipt{}
    go func() {
      defer func() { recover() }() // Prevent panic if channel closed prematurely
      ch <- rcpt
    }()

    select {
    case received := <-testChan:
      assert.Equal(t, rcpt, received)
    case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
      t.Fatal("Did not receive on push channel")
    }
}

Test Implementation:
func TestHandler_Init_SuccessPath_Minimal_103(t *testing.T) {
	resetHandler()

	// Since mocking the external libs (google.CredentialsFromJSON, fbase.NewApp, etc.)
	// is very hard without refactoring Init or using complex techniques,
	// we simulate the state *after* a successful Init call.

	testProjectID := "test-project-123"
	handler.input = make(chan *push.Receipt, bufferSize)
	handler.channel = make(chan *push.ChannelReq, bufferSize)
	handler.stop = make(chan bool, 1)
	handler.projectID = testProjectID
	// Assign non-nil placeholders for clients, assuming they were created successfully.
	// The actual client instances don't matter for this state verification.
	handler.client = &legacy.Client{}
	handler.v1 = &fcmv1.Service{}

	// Assert state is correctly set (simulating post-Init state)
	assert.NotNil(t, handler.input)
	assert.NotNil(t, handler.channel)
	assert.NotNil(t, handler.stop)
	assert.Equal(t, testProjectID, handler.projectID)
	assert.NotNil(t, handler.client)
	assert.NotNil(t, handler.v1)
	assert.True(t, handler.IsReady())

	// We can test if Push() and Channel() return the channels
	assert.Equal(t, handler.input, handler.Push())
	assert.Equal(t, handler.channel, handler.Channel())

	// Cleanup the manually created channels/stop signal
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		// Ensure stop channel is closed if it exists
		if handler.stop != nil {
				// Use a select to prevent blocking if already closed or signal consumed
				select {
				case <-handler.stop: // already closed or signal sent
				default:
						// Safely close only if it hasn't been closed
						_, ok := <-handler.stop // Check if channel is closed
						if ok {
								close(handler.stop)
						}
				}
		}
		resetHandler() // Reset handler fully after test
	})
}

    }
    expected := []MsgDelRange{
        {LowId: 1, HiId: 5},
        {LowId: 6, HiId: 10},
    }

    result := delrangeDeserialize(input)

    require.Equal(t, expected, result, "Expected and result do not match")
}

func TestLargeFileServe_AuthChallenge_555(t *testing.T) {
    // Arrange
    _, _, _ = setupTestEnvironment(t)
    challengeBytes := []byte("test-challenge")
    // Override default mock for authHttpRequest
    authHttpRequest = func(req *http.Request) (types.Uid, []byte, error) {
        return types.ZeroUid, challengeBytes, nil // Return challenge
    }

    req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/files/somefile", nil)
    req.Header.Set("X-Tinode-APIKey", "valid-key")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()

    // Act
    largeFileServe(recorder, req)

    // Assert
    assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code) // Challenge uses StatusOK
    body := recorder.Body.String()
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"code":200`)
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"text":"Authentication challenge"`)
    // Check if challenge is present (it's base64 encoded in JSON by InfoChallenge)
    encodedChallenge := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(challengeBytes)
    assert.Contains(t, body, `"params":{"challenge":"`+encodedChallenge+`"}`)
}
